short_description: HL7 ORM^O01 order message not routed to pharmacy system
description: MuleSoft HL7 ORM^O01 order message failed during routing to downstream pharmacy. The message contained an ORC segment with missing placer order number causing routing rule to drop the message silently.
error_message: HL7RouterException: No routing rule matched for ORM^O01 — ORC-2 placer order number is null
stack_trace:
org.mule.runtime.core.api.exception.MessagingException: HL7RouterException
  at com.mulesoft.connectors.hl7.internal.routing.HL7Router.route(HL7Router.java:112)
  at org.mule.runtime.core.internal.processor.chain.InterceptedReactiveProcessor.lambda$apply$0(InterceptedReactiveProcessor.java:55)
  at reactor.core.publisher.MonoFlatMap$FlatMapMain.onNext(MonoFlatMap.java:125)
Caused by: com.mulesoft.connectors.hl7.api.exception.HL7RouterException: ORC-2 is null — routing aborted
resolution_notes: Added null-check DataWeave guard on ORC-2 before routing. Missing placer order number now triggers a dead-letter queue entry and alerts the sending system with an HL7 ACK NAK response.

short_description: HL7 ORM^O01 missing PV1 segment causing patient visit lookup failure
description: Inbound HL7 ORM orders from the radiology modality worklist were missing the PV1 segment, causing downstream patient visit context lookup to throw a NullPointerException during DataWeave transformation.
error_message: DataWeaveMappingException: Cannot read field 'PV1.19' — PV1 segment is absent in ORM^O01 message
stack_trace:
org.mule.runtime.core.api.exception.MessagingException: DataWeaveMappingException
  at org.mule.runtime.module.extension.internal.runtime.operation.OperationMessageProcessor.process(OperationMessageProcessor.java:217)
  at org.mule.runtime.core.internal.processor.chain.InterceptedReactiveProcessor.lambda$apply$0(InterceptedReactiveProcessor.java:55)
Caused by: org.mule.runtime.api.el.ExpressionExecutionException: DataWeaveMappingException: Cannot read field 'PV1.19'
resolution_notes: Updated DataWeave transform to check for PV1 segment presence using isEmpty() guard. If PV1 absent, message is enriched with visit context from FHIR Encounter lookup before proceeding.

short_description: HL7 ORU^R01 lab result delivery failure — MLLP connection timeout to Epic EHR
description: Lab results ORU^R01 messages from the LIS system failed to deliver to Epic EHR via MLLP. The MuleSoft MLLP connector timed out after 30 seconds with no ACK received. Epic HL7 listener was unresponsive due to a downstream database lock.
error_message: MllpTimeoutException: No ACK received within 30000ms from Epic HL7 listener at hl7-epic-prod:2575
stack_trace:
org.mule.runtime.core.api.exception.MessagingException: MllpTimeoutException
  at com.mulesoft.connectors.mllp.internal.MllpOperations.send(MllpOperations.java:89)
  at org.mule.runtime.core.internal.processor.chain.InterceptedReactiveProcessor.lambda$apply$0(InterceptedReactiveProcessor.java:55)
Caused by: com.mulesoft.connectors.mllp.api.exception.MllpTimeoutException: ACK timeout after 30000ms
resolution_notes: Increased MLLP ACK timeout to 60 seconds. Added retry policy with 3 attempts and exponential backoff. Undelivered messages now persisted to Anypoint MQ dead-letter queue for replay.

short_description: HL7 ORU^R01 OBX segment mapping error — observation identifier missing
description: HL7 ORU result messages arriving from the laboratory information system had OBX segments where OBX-3 (observation identifier) was absent for certain panel results. DataWeave transformation failed with a mapping exception, preventing results from posting to the EHR.
error_message: DataWeaveMappingException: Cannot map OBX segment because OBX-3 observation identifier is missing
stack_trace:
org.mule.runtime.core.api.exception.MessagingException: DataWeaveMappingException
  at org.mule.runtime.module.extension.internal.runtime.operation.OperationMessageProcessor.process(OperationMessageProcessor.java:217)
Caused by: org.mule.runtime.api.el.ExpressionExecutionException: DataWeaveMappingException: Cannot map OBX segment because OBX-3 observation identifier is missing
resolution_notes: Added OBX-3 presence validation in DataWeave. OBX segments with missing observation identifiers are logged and skipped; a partial result acknowledgement is sent and the affected OBX is flagged for LIS resubmission.

short_description: OAuth2 SMART on FHIR token expiry — Epic access token not refreshed before expiry
description: MuleSoft FHIR patient query API failed to refresh its OAuth2 SMART on FHIR access token before expiry. Token TTL is 300 seconds but the refresh logic did not account for clock skew between MuleSoft CloudHub workers and Epic authorization server, causing a 401 Unauthorized flood.
error_message: HTTP 401 Unauthorized: Bearer token expired — epic-auth-server rejected access_token issued at 2026-04-16T08:00:00Z
stack_trace:
com.mulesoft.connectors.http.api.error.ResponseValidatorTypedException: Response code 401 mapped as failure
  at com.mulesoft.connectors.http.internal.request.ResponseValidator.validate(ResponseValidator.java:78)
  at com.mulesoft.connectors.http.internal.request.HttpRequestOperations.doRequest(HttpRequestOperations.java:220)
Caused by: org.mule.runtime.api.exception.MuleException: HTTP 401 Unauthorized
resolution_notes: Implemented proactive token refresh 60 seconds before expiry using a scheduler flow. Added clock-skew buffer of 30 seconds. Token stored in Anypoint Object Store with TTL-aware eviction.

short_description: OAuth2 token refresh failure — Cerner EHR client credentials flow returning 400
description: MuleSoft integration with Cerner EHR for clinical document retrieval started returning 400 Bad Request on token refresh. Investigation revealed the client_secret had been rotated in Cerner's developer portal but the new secret had not been updated in Anypoint Secrets Manager.
error_message: OAuth2TokenException: Token refresh failed — Cerner auth server returned 400 Bad Request: invalid_client
stack_trace:
org.mule.runtime.oauth.api.exception.RequestAuthenticationException: OAuth2TokenException
  at org.mule.runtime.oauth.internal.OAuthUtils.handleTokenRequestError(OAuthUtils.java:115)
  at org.mule.runtime.oauth.internal.ClientCredentialsOAuthDancer.refreshToken(ClientCredentialsOAuthDancer.java:203)
Caused by: org.mule.runtime.oauth.api.exception.OAuth2TokenException: invalid_client
resolution_notes: Rotated client_secret in Anypoint Secrets Manager to match Cerner developer portal. Added alerting on 400 responses from token endpoints to catch future secret rotation events within 5 minutes.

short_description: DataWeave NullPointerException — null FHIR Bundle payload in order processing flow
description: DataWeave transformation in the order processing flow threw a NullPointerException when the upstream FHIR Bundle payload was null. This occurred when the FHIR R4 server returned an empty Bundle for certain patient identifiers that had no active orders.
error_message: DataWeave script failed: NullPointerException evaluating expression payload.entry[0].resource — payload is null
stack_trace:
org.mule.runtime.core.api.exception.MessagingException: Script 'transform-fhir-bundle' failed
  at org.mule.runtime.module.extension.internal.runtime.operation.OperationMessageProcessor.process(OperationMessageProcessor.java:217)
Caused by: org.mule.runtime.api.el.ExpressionExecutionException: NullPointerException: payload is null
  at org.mule.weave.v2.runtime.DataWeaveExpressionLanguageAdaptor.evaluate(DataWeaveExpressionLanguageAdaptor.java:156)
resolution_notes: Added null guard in DataWeave using default operator: payload.entry default []. Empty Bundle now returns an empty array response with HTTP 204 instead of throwing an exception.

short_description: DataWeave FHIR R4 to HL7v2 mapping error — unsupported observation value type
description: DataWeave script responsible for translating FHIR R4 Observation resources to HL7v2 OBX segments failed when observation.value was of type Ratio, which was not handled in the type mapping logic. Only Quantity, CodeableConcept, and string types were covered.
error_message: DataWeave transformation error: Unsupported FHIR Observation value type 'Ratio' — no OBX-2/OBX-5 mapping defined
stack_trace:
org.mule.runtime.core.api.exception.MessagingException: DataWeave transformation error
  at org.mule.runtime.module.extension.internal.runtime.operation.OperationMessageProcessor.process(OperationMessageProcessor.java:217)
Caused by: org.mule.runtime.api.el.ExpressionExecutionException: Unsupported FHIR Observation value type 'Ratio'
resolution_notes: Extended DataWeave type-dispatch function to handle Ratio, SampledData, and Period value types. Ratio values are now encoded as OBX-2=NM with numerator/denominator formatted as 'n:d' in OBX-5.

short_description: CloudHub worker OutOfMemoryError — heap exhaustion in HL7 batch processing flow
description: MuleSoft CloudHub worker running the HL7 batch processing application crashed with an OutOfMemoryError during peak lab result submission window. The batch aggregator was accumulating HL7 messages in memory without flushing, causing heap exhaustion after approximately 4,000 messages.
error_message: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space — CloudHub worker hl7-batch-processor-worker-2 terminated
stack_trace:
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
  at java.util.Arrays.copyOf(Arrays.java:3236)
  at java.util.ArrayList.grow(ArrayList.java:265)
  at org.mule.runtime.core.internal.routing.ForkJoinStrategy.aggregateResults(ForkJoinStrategy.java:88)
  at com.mulesoft.mule.runtime.batchmodule.internal.engine.DefaultBatchEngine.accumulate(DefaultBatchEngine.java:312)
resolution_notes: Reduced batch aggregator max-size from unlimited to 500 messages. Enabled streaming processing to avoid in-memory accumulation. Upgraded CloudHub worker size from Medium (1.5GB) to Large (3.5GB) for peak windows.

short_description: CloudHub deployment timeout — application failed to start within 120 seconds
description: A new deployment of the FHIR patient integration application to CloudHub timed out during startup. The application failed to bind to its HTTP listener within the 120-second deployment window due to a misconfigured properties file referencing a non-existent Anypoint MQ queue.
error_message: CloudHubDeploymentException: Application fhir-patient-integration failed to start within 120s — HTTP listener did not bind on port 8081
stack_trace:
com.mulesoft.platform.cloudhub.api.CloudHubDeploymentException: Deployment timeout
  at com.mulesoft.platform.cloudhub.internal.DeploymentManager.waitForStart(DeploymentManager.java:445)
Caused by: org.mule.runtime.core.api.lifecycle.LifecycleException: Failed to start HTTP listener
  at org.mule.runtime.module.launcher.application.DefaultMuleApplication.start(DefaultMuleApplication.java:157)
Caused by: com.mulesoft.connectors.anypoint.mq.internal.MQOperations.connect(MQOperations.java:88): Queue 'fhir-patient-events-prod' does not exist
resolution_notes: Created missing Anypoint MQ queue 'fhir-patient-events-prod' in production environment. Added startup validation check that verifies all queue bindings exist before HTTP listener starts. Deployment succeeded after queue creation.
